notes.title: Kernelbay has officially landed on Steam! 🐟
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]I'm excited to officially open Kernelbay's Steam page as [i]Coming Soon[/i]!

Kernelbay is a cozy idle fishing game where you explore tiny handcrafted islands while your fisher sails, catches fish, and upgrades gear, all running quietly on your desktop as a transparent overlay.

[img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3686480/extras/Kernelbay_Descr_0.gif?t=1750166398"][/img]
[/p][p]We’ll keep updating this Hub with future development updates and release information.
In the meantime, your support means a lot — and feel free to leave any questions in the discussion area here:
👉 [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3686480/discussions/0/528723987504584417/"]Questions about Kernelbay[/url][/p][p]Thank you for following the journey![/p]
